title: The BEST Job Board for Finding New Opportunities?
description:
Finding the “perfect” job board really isn’t a thing since jobs gets posted everywhere but Google Jobs is really good. Compared to other job boards that are a single location for results Google Jobs pulls jobs from multiple sites to compile its results. #googlejobs #jobboard #jobsearch #jobseeker #indeed #linkedin #glassdoor #ziprecruiter

transcript: we are seriously sleeping on Google jobs if this is the first time you're seeing it it might look kind of interesting but if you look closer you'll notice that each job listed has like a job board attached to it and that's because Google jobs actually pulls from other job boards to give its results if you go to a job you'll notice you can see the different job boards where that job is posted so instead of going to like five or six different job boards at least start with Google jobs for your search because it's pulling from all those places anyways
